description: This source file defines the BroadcastChannelProviderBuilder class responsible for configuring broadcast channel providers for Orleans silos and clients. It also contains assembly attributes to register the provider. The class implements configuration methods for both silo and client builders.

classes.name: BroadcastChannelProviderBuilder
classes.description: A sealed class implementing provider builder interfaces for configuring broadcast channel providers for Orleans silos and clients.

methods.name: Configure (ISiloBuilder, string, IConfigurationSection)
methods.description: Configures the silo builder to add a broadcast channel using specified settings.

methods.name: Configure (IClientBuilder, string, IConfigurationSection)
methods.description: Configures the client builder to add a broadcast channel using specified settings.
